title: TPIX Launchpad
subtitle: Buy new TPIX Chain tokens with USDT on BSC — pay once, the tokens arrive in the same wallet on TPIX Chain
how1: Pick an amount and sign the order in your wallet (a signature, not a transaction — free)
how2: Send exactly that much USDT on BSC from the same wallet within {minutes} minutes
how3: The system buys the tokens for you on TPIX Chain and sends them to your wallet
riskShort: New tokens are high risk. You can lose everything you put in. Only buy with money you can afford to lose.
emptyBody: When a new token sale is approved it will appear here.
notOpenBody: You can browse the sale details, but orders are not being accepted right now.
notFound: This sale was not found or is not available.

sale.creator: Creator
sale.onChainNote: Every number on this page is read from the contracts — nobody can type them in by hand.

badges.subtitle: Read live from TPIX Chain. A green check is not a guarantee — it only shows what the contracts allow.

buy.title: Buy with USDT (BSC)
buy.amountInvalid: Enter a number with up to 6 decimals
buy.risk1: New tokens are high risk — the price can fall to zero and the pool can be thin. You can lose everything.
buy.risk2: Nobody guarantees a profit. TPIX only shows what the contracts allow; it does not vouch for the project.
buy.risk3: Send from your OWN wallet (this one). A withdrawal from an exchange will not buy tokens.
buy.risk4: Send only USDT on BSC, exactly {amount} USDT, within {minutes} minutes.
buy.risk5: A different amount, a late payment or a cancelled order does not buy tokens — you get USDT_TPIX on TPIX Chain instead, which you can withdraw at /bridge.
buy.acceptRisk: I have read the risks above and accept that I may lose the money I put in
buy.acceptOwnWallet: I will send from this wallet ({wallet}) — not from an exchange
buy.signHint: Signing is free and does not move any money.
buy.expired: The time to pay has passed
buy.insufficientBalance: Not enough USDT in this wallet
buy.sentNotice: Payment sent. The tokens usually arrive within a few minutes after the bridge sees it.
buy.alreadySent: You already sent a payment for this order — do not send again.
buy.cancelConfirm: Cancel this order? Do not cancel if you already sent the USDT.
buy.resumeNotice: You have an unfinished order for this sale — continue it below.
buy.openElsewhere: This wallet has an unfinished order on another sale. Finish or cancel it first.
buy.rejected: You rejected the request in your wallet
buy.insufficient: Not enough balance for the amount or the gas fee
buy.txFailed: The wallet could not send the transaction. Try again.
buy.switchFailed: Could not switch your wallet to the right chain
buy.walletChanged: Your wallet account changed — start the order again
buy.notLive: This sale is not open for buying right now
buy.gasNote: You need a little BNB in this wallet for the BSC gas fee.

statusBody.awaiting_payment: Send the exact amount on BSC. The bridge waits for the block to be final, then the purchase starts automatically.
statusBody.paid: Your USDT arrived. The system is buying your tokens on TPIX Chain.
statusBody.buying: The purchase transaction is on its way.
statusBody.delivered: {tokens} {symbol} were sent to your wallet on TPIX Chain.
statusBody.refunding: The sale could not take this purchase (closed, sold out or limits). Your money is being returned as USDT_TPIX on TPIX Chain.
statusBody.refunded: Your money was returned as USDT_TPIX on TPIX Chain. You can withdraw it back to BSC at the bridge.
statusBody.expired: No matching payment arrived in time. Anything you sent after that becomes USDT_TPIX in your wallet on TPIX Chain.
statusBody.cancelled: This order was cancelled. A payment sent afterwards becomes USDT_TPIX in your wallet on TPIX Chain.
statusBody.needs_review: Staff are checking this order by hand. Your money is safe — please wait.

admin.title: Launchpad
admin.subtitle: Approve sale pages, watch orders that need a person, and read user reports. Money moves only through the CLI agent.

register.title: Register a sale from chain
register.body: Paste the FixedPriceSale address created by LaunchpadFactory. Everything is read from chain; it starts as pending.

admin.confirmApprove: Approve {symbol}? The sale page goes live and accepts orders.
admin.confirmHide: Hide {symbol}? The page disappears and new orders stop. Paid orders still finish.
admin.cliOnly: Resolving stuck orders and transactions is done on the server with the CLI (launchpad:deliver) — this page only shows them.
